landing.heading: Track your order
landing.intro: Enter your order number and the email address used to place it. We'll send a one-time verification code to that email.
landing.emailOnlyNotice: Verification is currently by email only.
landing.confirmation: If the details you entered match an eligible order, a verification code has been sent.
landing.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

verify.heading: Enter verification code
verify.intro: We sent a 6-digit code to your email. It expires in 10 minutes.
verify.attemptsNotice: For your security, only a limited number of attempts are allowed.
verify.invalidCode: That code is invalid or has expired.
verify.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please request a new code.

session.expired: Your secure session has ended. Please verify again to continue.
session.unauthorized: This tracking session is invalid, expired, or has been revoked.

order.loadError: We couldn't load your order right now. Please try again shortly.

payment.heading: Payment
payment.changeSuccess: Your payment method has been updated.
payment.changeRejected: This payment method could not be applied to your order.
payment.notEligible: This order can no longer have its payment method changed here — please contact support.

invoice.heading: Invoice
invoice.notAvailable: No invoice is available for this order yet.
invoice.pdfError: The PDF could not be downloaded right now. Please try again.

support.heading: Support
support.historyEmpty: You have no support requests for this order yet.
support.descriptionPlaceholder: Add any details that will help us help you
support.submitSuccess: Your request has been submitted for review.
support.returnIntakeNotice: This creates a request for our team to review — it does not automatically issue a refund or approve a return.

notAvailableReason.not_yet_delivered: This type of request is only available after your order has been delivered.
notAvailableReason.delivery_timestamp_unavailable: This type of request isn't available for this order right now — please use General Support instead.
notAvailableReason.post_delivery_window_expired: This type of request is only available within 30 days of delivery. Please use General Support instead.

errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.
